bio.text: Rodneyse Bichotte Hermelyn represents the 42nd Assembly District in Brooklyn (Ditmas Park, Flatbush, East Flatbush and Midwood) and became a legislator in 2015; her Assembly biography also lists her as Majority Whip.
She was elected a District Leader in 2010 and is described as the first Haitian American woman elected in New York City.
Her earlier career included work as a public school math teacher, a telecommunications engineer and an investment banker.

She holds an MBA from Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management, an MS in electrical engineering from Illinois Institute of Technology and a BS in electrical engineering from SUNY Buffalo, and earned a J.D. from Brooklyn Law School in 2024.
